scientific_limitations: Only the exact displayed primitive integral plane model and its fibers at 2, 3 and 5 are covered.
Zeta functions count possibly singular/nonreduced projective fibers, not smooth genus-six normalizations or semistable models.
The four-node/six-cusp geometric characteristic-five basket has prior coverage; only the arithmetic Frobenius correction and complete bad-prime zeta statement are assessed here.
Unindexed historical computations could have anticipated an equivalent point-count identity.
title: Bad-prime zeta functions and projective geometry of Wiman's plane sextic
